detail.description: Measurement or reason, e.g. `needs 52 GB VRAM`
detail.title: Detail

hosts.description: Hosts whose policy and calibration allow it
hosts.title: Hosts

status.description: null = not calibrated on any host

DataClass.description: Routing policy class of a job, asset or cast entry (spec: Sicherheit, Datenklassen).
DataClass.title: DataClass

notice.description: Licence disclosure shown in the UI (WanGP requires one)
notice.title: Notice

version.description: Pinned upstream commit or version; null when not provisioned
version.title: Version

cuda_driver_ok.description: Driver new enough for the GPU (Blackwell needs CUDA 12.8+); null if no NVIDIA GPU
cuda_driver_ok.title: Cuda Driver Ok

disk_free_mb.description: Free space on the drive that holds the data directory
disk_free_mb.title: Disk Free Mb

notes.description: Findings worth showing, one sentence each
notes.title: Notes

cancel.description: Job ids the worker must cancel
cancel.title: Cancel

message.description: Cause and consequence in one sentence
message.title: Message

seed.description: null = random, resolved by the core and recorded
seed.title: Seed

model.description: Pin a registry model; null lets the router choose
model.title: Model

recipe.description: Phase 2; rejected with 501 until recipes exist

wait_seconds.description: Long-poll up to this many seconds
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

commercial_use.description: null when the licence needs a case-by-case reading
commercial_use.title: Commercial Use

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `type` is a URN such as `urn:cinewright:problem:not-implemented`.
Problem.title: Problem

Provenance.description: Sidecar record of one asset. Field order follows the spec; missing values stay null.
Provenance.title: Provenance

approval_threshold_eur.description: Remote and cloud jobs above it need approval
approval_threshold_eur.title: Approval Threshold Eur

url.description: Core URL the worker downloads the input from
url.title: Url

engine_model.description: Engine-side model id from the registry binding
engine_model.title: Engine Model

prompt.description: Already translated into the model's prompt dialect
prompt.title: Prompt

token.description: Bearer token for all further worker calls; the core stores only its hash
token.title: Token

models.description: Engine model ids (e.g. Wan2GP model_type) this worker can serve
models.title: Models

info.description: The only API of Cinewright. Web UI, MCP server and workers are its clients. Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.
info.title: Cinewright internal API

requestBody.description: Input file (image, clip or audio) as raw bytes; Content-Type names the media type.

200.description: Server-sent events; each `data:` line is a JobEvent

requestBody.description: Output file as raw bytes; Content-Type names the media type.
